title: A Delayed Flight Home
paragraphs: After a long work conference, Fahmi arrives at the airport ready to finally go home, only to learn that his flight has been delayed by nearly five hours due to unexpected weather conditions.

Frustrated at first, he considers complaining loudly at the counter, but instead decides to find a quiet corner, catch up on missed messages, and pray Maghrib calmly in the airport's small prayer room.

While waiting, he strikes up a conversation with another delayed passenger heading to a nearby city, and the two share stories about their work trips, making the wait feel considerably shorter than expected.
When the flight finally boards, Fahmi feels surprisingly unbothered by the long delay, realizing that how he chose to spend the waiting time mattered more than the delay itself.
